title: Research: classify the P112 masked decoder coordinate component (no new kappa)
head: 8867cf20fbe0d3960f68bcffca118a5ac0624f7f
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Masked decoders leave the odd-pair entries unconstrained, so the existing all-pairs copy-cost floor does not directly apply. This scoped research result classifies the entire complex connected component containing the standard P112 eight-term decoder: every point is a factor-basis change and reciprocal row scaling of an all-pairs decoder. Consequently every continuous path of exact eight-term masked solutions from that starting point retains copy cost at least 64.

Both factors may leave the root-coordinate space. The exact 6,720 × 1,792 Jacobian has rank 1,617 and nullity 175. A written open-and-closed orbit argument extends the tangent calculation to the whole component, including exclusion of escape through deficient-rank factors. This is stronger than the trivial local floor from support persistence.

**No new κ or physical supplier is claimed.** Disconnected components, discrete/approximate searches and decoders with nine or more terms remain open. The cost corollary inherits PR1077/968's geometric classification premise and separate-term pairing-rank convention. All physical/compiler, hosting, precision/tape and analytic obligations remain unchanged.

The research package and its path-scoped `.github/workflows/p112-masked-tangent-audit.yml` workflow are added. Start with README.md and PROOF.md; the selected frontier, upstream and frozen inputs are untouched.

## Task and overlap

Base: `1b59b624d21924f8e3537cdc1ac52d3be6eda2fe`, verified as current main before submission. Task selector: `complex-masked-decoder`, nonce `c4cb3fadd3712193711993a2fb0dac76`; TASK.md records the bounded domain and method.

PR1191 (`640b43bb13d3d476a2d83b74ef0d33f14d1b5711`) proves one-sided root-linear masked rigidity for arbitrary term count. This result instead treats two unrestricted factors, eight terms and one connected component. PR1180 (`75b408646d558147a4eb250fc407d1fbfcb8df4e`) treats overcomplete all-pairs root-linear factors. Discussion1210 proposes an arbitrary-term root-star support census; it is complementary and remains provisional. Exact predecessor heads and source hashes are in SOURCES.json. The final overlap scan covered 820 open PRs including drafts through #1211 and all six active discussions.

## Validation

Python 3.10+; standard library only:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/p112-masked-tangent-audit/verify.py
python3 -I -B research/p112-masked-tangent-audit/independent.py
python3 -I -B research/p112-masked-tangent-audit/test_package.py
```

Passed on macOS arm64 / CPython 3.14.7:

- Primary sparse F101 elimination checks a 1,617-square minor and 175 independent integer kernel directions; nine semantic controls pass.
- Separate symmetric/antisymmetric F3 bitset implementation obtains ranks 868 + 749, integer kernel dimensions 28 + 147, and six control groups.
- Five package tests cover optimized isolated relocation, read-only replay, corrupted evidence, changed/missing proofs and omitted source pins.
- PR1077's complete scoped verifier, selected-record integrity, five named selected-record tests and whitespace checks pass.

The proof and code received separate AI review; the identified source-inventory hardening is included. No Lean, full selected-supplier cold replay or independent human mathematical review is claimed. VALIDATION.md records commands and limits.

## Hosted CI

[The focused GitHub Actions run](https://github.com/DavidAriasC/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38462049339) **passed** on Ubuntu 24.04 with **Python 3.10 and 3.14**, for PR head `8867cf20fbe0d3960f68bcffca118a5ac0624f7f`. Both jobs passed the primary and independent certificates, optimized relocation/rejection controls, inherited complex-floor replay, selected-record integrity/regressions, and unchanged-tracked-files check. No test failures required mathematical or verifier changes.

These are **fork-hosted** results. Upstream fork workflows remain behind GitHub's maintainer-approval gate; they are not represented as passed. The unfiltered historical fork suites were canceled because they do not cover this package. Their workflows and tests were not changed.
